messages:
Samira: RCA published for 2026-08-14 canary rollback during model swap. Link: <https://docs.redwood.com/rca/3001|RCA: canary rollback on model-swap due to metric drift>. Short summary: a canary model rollout showed quality drift in generated structured outputs; automatic rollback triggered, but rollback path served an older variant without expected prompt-mapping, causing a brief mismatch in response format for ~9 minutes. Impact: ~0.6% of requests had unexpected structured fields. No PII exposure.

Samira: Owners and immediate asks below. Please confirm ETAs and blockers.

ACTIONS (owners):
- Patch rollback path to include prompt-mapping compatibility checks (Ben) — PR + canary by 2026-08-18.
- Add a canary-quality synthetic that validates structured output schema before allowing global roll (Olivia) — alert + job by 2026-08-16.
- Re-run canary with injected schema-edge cases (eng-sre / Jacob) — replay by 2026-08-20.

Ben: Taking the rollback compatibility check. I'll include a small migration shim to handle older variants and add unit tests.

Olivia: Will add the synthetic check. Propose using existing eval harness and adding schema assertions. Posting spec in #eng-ml.

release-bot: RCA 3001 published and incident INC-37021 tracked; owners: Ben, Olivia, Jacob, Samira.

Jacob: Eng-sre will coordinate the replay. Need the canary traffic sample and list of schema edge cases from Olivia. Scheduling tentative run for 08/19 07:00 PT.

Samira: Uploaded canary traces and failing examples: <https://internal.redwood.com/replays/serve-20260814|canary bundle>. Includes notes on schema mismatches.

Olivia: Draft exec blurb: "On 2026-08-14 an automated canary rollback during a model swap exposed schema drift in a small subset of responses. We rolled back the canary, added compatibility and schema checks, and are revalidating; fixes targeted by 2026-08-20. No customer data was exposed."

Ben: LGTM.

Jacob: Replay scheduled 08/19 — will post results and pass/fail criteria in this thread.

Samira: Please update INC-37021 with PR links and canary results. Weekly checkpoint invite sent for 2026-08-17 10:00 PT. Using this thread as single source-of-truth for follow-ups.

Olivia: Will post synthetic job link when ready.

Ben: Opening PR now and will tag reviewers.

Samira: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers, escalate to oncall.
